response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong, versatile senior/staff engineer with deep full-stack, systems, and open-source experience, but he lacks the German C1 proficiency explicitly required for this role (listed as 'Basic'), and his resume shows no clear track record of formal team leadership, client-facing architecture consulting, or UML-based modeling — all core requirements for this Head of Development position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, hands-on software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Strong open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining his own GIS platform (GISCollective)
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and domains across many different employers and stacks
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum for this role
No evidence of formal team leadership, mentoring, or client advisory responsibilities in his employment history
No mention of UML, formal architecture modeling, IT security/compliance, or Python — key desired skills for this position

key_factors.factor: German language proficiency below required C1
Lack of demonstrated formal leadership/team management experience
Strong technical breadth and open-source/Linux affinity
